messages:
Maria (PM): Customer request: CSV billing export should include a link to an example trace for rows with sampled spans. Need format and safety constraints.
Anya (Data): Agree. We should add `sample_trace_id` (nullable) and a pre-signed `trace_link` that expires. Export will be hourly rollups, so trace is an exemplar, not full fidelity.
Jake (Eng): Tech constraints: generate trace_link only if we have a sampled span in that rollup. We must URL-encode trace ids and use short token TTL (e.g., 24h). Exports should be async + S3 for large ranges.
Sam (SRE): Safety: ensure trace_link is tenant-scoped and checks session or signed token. Also rate-limit export jobs per-tenant and paginate to avoid heavy DB scans.
Lukas (Design): UX: export modal should show a note: "Traces linked are sampled exemplars; absence of a link means no sampled trace in window." Provide example CSV header in modal.
Anya (Data): Proposed CSV header:
`tenant_id,route,model_id,event_time,tokens_in,tokens_out,normalized_usd,charge_usd,sample_trace_id,trace_link`
Sample row: `acct_42,/v1/embeddings,redwood-7b,2025-06-01T05:00:00Z,50,0,0.012,0.12,abc123,https://console.redwood.ai/traces/abc123?t=acct_42&exp=20250602`
Maria (PM): Launch checklist draft:
- CSV includes sample_trace_id + trace_link (when available)
- trace_link tokens expire and are tenant-scoped
- Export is async and delivered to S3/console area
- Docs explain sampling selection and that exemplar may not represent all events in the row
- Perf: 90-day mid-tier export completes under 30m or queues with progress
Jake (Eng): Action: spike for export worker + signed URL flow. ETA 5 days.
Sam (SRE): I'll run canary after spike and report CPU/DB impact.
Lukas (Design): I'll add export modal copy and example CSV preview.
BillingBot: Export job queued id=exp-1801230000-1 ETA ~10m
DeployBot: Canary deploy scheduled 2025-06-03T14:00:00Z flag=billing-csv-traces
Maria (PM): Thanks all. We'll review canary metrics next sync.
